description: This file defines a utility object for handling errors centrally in an Android Kotlin application. It manages different error types, logs relevant analytics events, and displays error messages via Snackbar, with optional retry actions.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Singleton object providing methods to handle errors uniformly across the app, including error categorization, analytics logging, and user notification.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles different types of Throwable errors, logs relevant analytics events, and displays appropriate error messages with optional retry functionality.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message to the user via a Snackbar, with support for an optional retry callback.
